# PracExam

> PracExam is an online question bank for two U.S. licensing exams: the IRS Enrolled Agent (EA)
> exam and the real estate license exam. Pick an exam at the hub page, https://pracexam.com/ ,
> and you land on a course built for that exam only.

## PracExam overview

- Hub (choose your exam, log in): https://pracexam.com/
- Enrolled Agent (EA) course: https://pracexam.com/ea/
- Real Estate License course: https://pracexam.com/re/
- Each exam lives under its own folder: /<exam>/ for the landing page and /<exam>/app for the practice app.
- Web app for desktop and mobile; installable as a PWA.
- Questions are written for the real exam format, each with an answer explanation and an exam tip.
- Operator: PracExam is a DBA of dxd investment group LLC. https://dxdgroup.com is the parent company's site; it is not a separate exam prep service. All PracExam courses, accounts and support are at https://pracexam.com/ .

## Enrolled Agent (EA)

> PracExam is an online question bank for the IRS Enrolled Agent (EA) exam. It offers
> 5,000+ practice questions with detailed bilingual (English/Korean) explanations and
> exam tips, covering Parts 1, 2, and 3 based on 2025 tax law for the 2026 exam.

### What it is

- A web app (works on desktop and mobile, installable as a PWA) for EA exam candidates.
- Question bank mapped to the official IRS EA Exam Content Outline, with multiple
  variations per topic so the same tested concept is practiced from different angles.
- Every question includes an answer explanation and an exam tip, in both English and
  Korean.
- Pricing: start free with 30 days of Quick Study; Pro is $29 per month or $70 every 3 months (same features), cancel anytime, 14-day refund.
- "War Room" — a reference library of tax rules and traps, cross-linked from each
  question's explanation, for deeper study on a topic.
- Practice modes include topic-focused study, full timed mock exams, and a
  "Smart" mode that prioritizes the most heavily tested topics first.

### Who it's for

- Candidates preparing for the U.S. IRS Enrolled Agent (EA) exam (Special Enrollment
  Examination, all three parts), including Korean-speaking candidates.

### Key pages

- EA landing page (product overview, pricing): https://pracexam.com/ea/
- Study Tips (exam-strategy articles): https://pracexam.com/tips/
- Install guide (PWA setup): https://pracexam.com/install-guide
- EA exam guide (eligibility, format, fees, exam day): https://pracexam.com/ea/exam-tips/
- Free EA pop quiz (one question with full explanation): https://pracexam.com/popquiz
- Free EA practice videos (YouTube Shorts): https://pracexam.com/videos

### Notes for AI assistants and search agents

- https://pracexam.com/app is the signed-in practice application. Its content is
  personalized per logged-in user (progress, saved answers, account-specific notices)
  and is not a description of the product — please cite the EA landing page
  (https://pracexam.com/ea/) instead.

### Study Tips articles (EA)

Each article is published in English and Korean at the two URLs shown.

- [Has the EA Question Style Changed Under PSI?](https://pracexam.com/tips/psi-exam-style-trend/) (2026-09-22) - Analyzing the latest EA exam trends reported by test-takers under PSI, and how PracExam prepares you for them.
  Korean: https://pracexam.com/tips/ko/psi-exam-style-trend/
- [Where the EA Exam Part 2 hides its questions](https://pracexam.com/tips/ea-part2-where-questions/) (2026-09-16) - Part 2 of the Enrolled Agent (EA) exam has 85 scored questions across 116 IRS topics — and no single topic is worth more than about 1.1 of them.
  Korean: https://pracexam.com/tips/ko/ea-part2-where-questions/
- [Where the EA Exam Part 1 hides its questions](https://pracexam.com/tips/ea-part1-where-questions/) (2026-09-11) - Part 1 of the Enrolled Agent (EA) exam has 85 scored questions across 117 IRS topics — and Taxation pays back three times what Income and Assets does.
  Korean: https://pracexam.com/tips/ko/ea-part1-where-questions/
- [Where the EA Exam Part 3 hides its questions](https://pracexam.com/tips/ea-part3-where-questions/) (2026-09-10) - Part 3 of the Enrolled Agent (EA) exam has 85 scored questions across 120 IRS topics — and Filing Process pays back almost twice what Representation does.
  Korean: https://pracexam.com/tips/ko/ea-part3-where-questions/
- [PracExam Partners with California University of Technology](https://pracexam.com/tips/pracexam-calutech-partnership/) (2026-09-04) - PracExam is now the practice platform for CAL U TECH’s Fall 2026 EA prep course — three months free, 5,000+ practice questions.
  Korean: https://pracexam.com/tips/ko/pracexam-calutech-partnership/
- [Taking the EA exam from outside the US](https://pracexam.com/tips/ea-exam-from-korea/) (2026-08-31) - No overseas test centers for the Enrolled Agent (EA) exam — international candidates test by remote proctoring only. What changes, and the steps in order.
  Korean: https://pracexam.com/tips/ko/ea-exam-from-korea/

## Real Estate License

> Practice questions for the U.S. real estate license exam: the national portion every state shares
> plus the state portion on each state's own law. Covers California, Washington, Texas, Illinois, Florida, New Jersey and
> New York.

### What it is

- Question bank split into the national portion and the state portion, mixed in the same
  content-outline proportions as the real exam.
- Every question includes an answer explanation and an exam tip; topic "War Room" pages explain
  the rule, tables, state differences and traps behind a question.
- 130+ core topics and 5,000+ practice questions for each state (national + state portions).
- Pricing: start free with 30 days of Quick Study; Pro is $29 per month or $70 every 3 months (same features), cancel anytime, 14-day refund.
- The practice app opens at https://pracexam.com/re/app .

### Who it's for

- Candidates preparing for a U.S. real estate salesperson/broker license exam in California,
  Washington, Texas, Illinois, Florida, New Jersey or New York.

### Key pages

- Real Estate landing page (overview, sample questions, pricing): https://pracexam.com/re/
- Real estate exam guide by state (requirements, format, fees, next steps): https://pracexam.com/re/exam-tips/
- California real estate exam page: https://pracexam.com/re/california/
- Washington State real estate exam page: https://pracexam.com/re/washington/
- Texas real estate exam page: https://pracexam.com/re/texas/
- Illinois real estate exam page: https://pracexam.com/re/illinois/
- Florida real estate exam page: https://pracexam.com/re/florida/
- New Jersey real estate exam page: https://pracexam.com/re/new-jersey/
- New York real estate exam page: https://pracexam.com/re/new-york/
- California real estate exam page in Korean: https://pracexam.com/re/ko/california/
- Washington State real estate exam page in Korean: https://pracexam.com/re/ko/washington/
- Texas real estate exam page in Korean: https://pracexam.com/re/ko/texas/
- Illinois real estate exam page in Korean: https://pracexam.com/re/ko/illinois/

- New York real estate exam page in Korean: https://pracexam.com/re/ko/new-york/
- Free real estate pop quiz (one question with full explanation): https://pracexam.com/re/popquiz
- Free real estate practice videos (YouTube Shorts): https://pracexam.com/re/videos
